title: Knowledge Graph-Based Hypothesis Generation and Experimental Validation in Yeast
summary: The versioned primary abstract reports new gene-chemical interaction hypotheses in nonpathogenic laboratory yeast, supported by automated growth assays after multiple-testing correction. Interaction support does not establish full mechanism.
organization: Chalmers University of Technology; University of Gothenburg
